title: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 스토킹범죄 사건의 심리 및 재판 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the procedures for hearings and trials of cases involving crimes of stalking under the Act on Punishment of Crime of Stalking (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
